title: Insta360 X6 In-Depth Review: Worth The Upgrade?
content:
<span data-mce-type="bookmark" style="display: inline-block; width: 0px; overflow: hidden; line-height: 0;" class="mce_SELRES_start">﻿</span>

I’ve just published my full Insta360 X6 In-Depth Review up on YouTube; this is after almost two months of usage with the camera, across all sorts of different scenarios. From trails to mountains to cities to underwater, and plenty more. Hundreds of clips/videos, plus tons of comparison footage against the GoPro Max 2 and DJI OSMO 360. It’s an interestingly close race these days, but it’s clear that Insta360 is making a notable difference through a number of software features – rather than straight hardware upgrades (though there are many of those too).

In any case, here are all the chapters for the video (which link to each section):
